_readme: R1-streets world textures. Maps: *_albedo (sRGB), *_normal (OpenGL +Y, linear), *_orm (R=AO, G=roughness, B=metalness, linear), *.png = RGBA decal/atlas (sRGB, straight alpha), *_rough = roughness for a decal. real_world_m = [U,V] metres covered by the whole texture. Real-photo derived unless noted; sources in 'sources' and references/credits/R1-streets.md.

ac_outdoor_unit_front_a.purpose: Front face of a real split-type AC outdoor unit (fan grille + side panel), rectified. Map on a bevelled box (sides: tinted plain from the albedo edge colour); hang on wall brackets with a drip stain decal below.

ac_outdoor_unit_front_b.purpose: Front face of a real split-type AC outdoor unit (fan grille + side panel), rectified. Map on a bevelled box (sides: tinted plain from the albedo edge colour); hang on wall brackets with a drip stain decal below.

asphalt_main_worn.purpose: Main-road asphalt: lighter, coarse aggregate, fewer patches, sealed cracks, oil drips in lane centres.
asphalt_main_worn.method: procedural layout/wear (modelled on Thai references, see NOTES.md) over CC0 Poly Haven photo-scan detail

asphalt_soi_patched.purpose: Soi / side-street asphalt: tired, dusty, saw-cut utility patch and square repairs, black sealed cracks, oil and food stains.
asphalt_soi_patched.source: detail from Poly Haven worn_asphalt + asphalt_02 (CC0)
asphalt_soi_patched.method: procedural layout/wear (modelled on Thai references, see NOTES.md) over CC0 Poly Haven photo-scan detail

awning_stripes_green_white_photo.purpose: Green/white striped awning canvas from a real fabric photo; stripes along V; tileable. Add rain-streak / grime decals (decal_wall_grime_streaks_photo) for the dirty Thai look.

awning_stripes_red_pink_photo.purpose: Faded red striped awning canvas from a real fabric photo; stripes along V; tileable. Add rain-streak / grime decals (decal_wall_grime_streaks_photo) for the dirty Thai look.

awning_stripes_red_yellow_photo.purpose: Red/yellow striped awning canvas from a real fabric photo; stripes along V; tileable. Add rain-streak / grime decals (decal_wall_grime_streaks_photo) for the dirty Thai look.

cable_black_rubber_photo.purpose: Black rubber cable surface from a real close-up photo of power cables, rotated so cables run along U; tiles along U. Map onto tube geometry (U along the wire).

concrete_slab_footpath.purpose: Plain broom-finished concrete slab (provincial footpath, soi surface, shop forecourt, market floor) with sawn joints every 1 m, cracks, a patch, stains, gum.
concrete_slab_footpath.method: procedural layout/wear (modelled on Thai references, see NOTES.md) over CC0 Poly Haven photo-scan detail

corrugated_zinc_rusty.purpose: Rusty galvanised corrugated sheet (สังกะสี) - albedo from a real photo, corrugation normal from Poly Haven rusty_corrugated_iron (CC0). Corrugations run along V. Back alleys, lean-to roofs, stall roofs, empty-lot fences.

corrugated_zinc_streaked.purpose: Galvanised corrugated sheet with rust streaks - albedo from a real photo, corrugation normal from Poly Haven rusty_corrugated_iron (CC0). Corrugations run along V. Back alleys, lean-to roofs, stall roofs, empty-lot fences.

curb_bare_concrete.purpose: Unpainted dirty concrete curb for sois/markets. UV unfolded curb profile, U along the curb (tiles in U, 2.0 m), V across the profile (0.5 m): V 0.00-0.40 (image top) = top surface, sidewalk edge at the very top; V 0.40-0.48 = rounded arris; V 0.48-1.00 = road-facing vertical face, bottom row = road level with gutter grime and tyre scuffs. Precast joints every 1 m.
curb_bare_concrete.method: procedural layout/wear (modelled on Thai references, see NOTES.md) over CC0 Poly Haven photo-scan detail

curb_red_white.purpose: Red/white painted curb (ขอบทางขาวแดง = no stopping/parking at all). 0.5 m paint blocks, worn & dirty. UV unfolded curb profile, U along the curb (tiles in U, 2.0 m), V across the profile (0.5 m): V 0.00-0.40 (image top) = top surface, sidewalk edge at the very top; V 0.40-0.48 = rounded arris; V 0.48-1.00 = road-facing vertical face, bottom row = road level with gutter grime and tyre scuffs. Precast joints every 1 m.
curb_red_white.method: procedural layout/wear (modelled on Thai references, see NOTES.md) over CC0 Poly Haven photo-scan detail

curb_white_yellow.purpose: White/yellow painted curb (ขอบทางขาวเหลือง = no parking, brief pick-up/drop-off allowed; bus stops, school gates). UV unfolded curb profile, U along the curb (tiles in U, 2.0 m), V across the profile (0.5 m): V 0.00-0.40 (image top) = top surface, sidewalk edge at the very top; V 0.40-0.48 = rounded arris; V 0.48-1.00 = road-facing vertical face, bottom row = road level with gutter grime and tyre scuffs. Precast joints every 1 m.
curb_white_yellow.method: procedural layout/wear (modelled on Thai references, see NOTES.md) over CC0 Poly Haven photo-scan detail

curb_yellow_black.purpose: Yellow/black painted curb (ขอบทางเหลืองดำ = obstruction marker: traffic islands, median noses, pillars, bridge piers). UV unfolded curb profile, U along the curb (tiles in U, 2.0 m), V across the profile (0.5 m): V 0.00-0.40 (image top) = top surface, sidewalk edge at the very top; V 0.40-0.48 = rounded arris; V 0.48-1.00 = road-facing vertical face, bottom row = road level with gutter grime and tyre scuffs. Precast joints every 1 m.
curb_yellow_black.method: procedural layout/wear (modelled on Thai references, see NOTES.md) over CC0 Poly Haven photo-scan detail

decal_cigarette_butts_photo.purpose: Cigarette butts cut from a real photo of a gutter (alpha = butts). Use along kerbs, under the win-motosai bench, around shop steps.

decal_flyers_loan_cluster_photo.purpose: Cluster of photocopied 'เงินด่วน' loan flyers cut from a real B&W photo of a utility pole (alpha = paper). Wrap around concrete poles / walls at 1.2-2.0 m.

decal_gum_spots_photo.purpose: Flattened chewing-gum spots extracted from a real pavement photo (joints removed). Scatter near shop doors, bus stops, 7-Eleven fronts.

decal_litter_atlas.purpose: Litter atlas cut from real product/street photos (background keyed out): plastic bags (blue/white/pink), crushed PET bottle, iced-coffee cup, striped cup with straw, styrofoam food boxes, crushed can, snack wrapper, bottle caps. 4x3 cells of 256 px; per-cell UVs (v from top) and real sizes in 'atlas'. Use as alpha-tested ground decals / tiny quads around bins, stalls, kerbs.

decal_moss_photo.purpose: Moss / algae patches extracted from real photos of damp concrete (alpha = green growth + dark damp). Wall bases, canal walls, shaded corners, drain edges.

decal_oil_stains_photo.purpose: Oil / grease stains extracted from real photos of stained concrete (alpha = darkening). 2x2 atlas; multiply-dark, lower roughness under the stain.

decal_potholes_photo.purpose: Potholes / broken asphalt cut from real photos with soft elliptical alpha (blend over asphalt). 2x2 atlas, some water-filled.

decal_puddles_photo.purpose: Cluster of puddle shapes extracted from a real photo of wet asphalt after rain (alpha = standing water; RGB = dark muddy water so the renderer's env map / neon supplies the reflection; stretched to undo the photo's foreshortening). Pair with decal_puddles_photo_rough (water ~0.04).

decal_torn_posters_photo.purpose: Layers of torn / peeled posters cut from real wall photos (ragged alpha edges). Pillars, poles, shutter boxes, walls near the market.

decal_wall_grime_streaks_photo.purpose: Black water / mould streaks extracted from real photos of tropical concrete walls (alpha = darkening). Place under ledges, AC units, balconies, roof edges.

gate_folding_steel.purpose: Folding steel security gate ('ประตูยืด', scissor lattice) closed across a shop front (real photo, rectified). _albedo = opaque version (gate over dark interior); gate_folding_steel_alpha.png = lattice keyed out (alpha-test, cutoff ~0.4).

manhole_double_drain_cover.purpose: Real double cast-iron drain cover (Pattaya City, fish relief, drain slots) in concrete surround - kerbside drain inlet / footpath.

manhole_round_iron.purpose: Real round cast-iron manhole cover (diamond studs, lifting slots), top-down photo, circular alpha. Diameter ~0.75 m incl. frame.

manhole_square_bma.purpose: Real Bangkok (BMA) square cast-iron footpath manhole with fish relief, in its concrete surround; drop-in footpath tile (photo, top-down, lighting evened).

paver_interlock_I.purpose: Interlocking dog-bone ('ตัวหนอน') concrete pavers, grey with random faded-red ones: shop forecourts, soi parking, market lanes, petrol-station edges. Oil stains, gum, moss in joints.
paver_interlock_I.method: procedural layout/wear (modelled on Thai references, see NOTES.md) over CC0 Poly Haven photo-scan detail

roadline_double_yellow_photo.purpose: Double solid yellow centre line cut from a real top-down road photo (alpha = paint, asphalt removed). Tiles along V.

roadline_white_dashed_photo.purpose: White dashed lane line from a real top-down photo (alpha = paint).

roadline_white_edge_photo.purpose: Worn white edge line from a real road photo (alpha = paint). Tiles along V.

roadline_yellow_single_photo.purpose: Single solid yellow line (no-parking edge / centre line) cut from a real top-down road photo (alpha = paint). Tiles along V.

roadmark_zebra_worn_photo.purpose: Badly worn zebra-crossing bars cut from a real top-down photo (cracked, patchy paint; alpha = paint). Bars run along X.

shutter_closed_graffiti.purpose: Whole closed roller shutter, cream, with a big purple graffiti throw-up (real photo, rectified).

shutter_closed_rusty_white.purpose: Whole closed roller shutter with its housing box (real photo, rectified): white paint, rust bleeding along every slat. One shophouse bay; box = top 15%.

shutter_slats_painted_green.purpose: Painted (green/blue) roller-shutter slats with chipped paint and rust - real photo scan from Poly Haven "painted_metal_shutter" (CC0). Slats run along U; tileable.

shutter_slats_rust_brown.purpose: Roller-shutter slats, fully rusted brown (real photo, made tileable). Slats run along U; ~8 cm slat pitch.

shutter_slats_rusty_scan.purpose: Rusty galvanised roller-shutter slats - real photo scan from Poly Haven "rusty_metal_shutter" (CC0). Slats run along U; tileable.

sidewalk_tile_chain_grey.purpose: Newer BMA footpath tile: 40x40 cm grey pressed concrete, coin + double racetrack grooves over a small-square grid, alternate tiles rotated; dirt in grooves.
sidewalk_tile_chain_grey.method: procedural layout/wear (modelled on Thai references, see NOTES.md) over CC0 Poly Haven photo-scan detail

sidewalk_tile_circles_grey.purpose: Bangkok footpath: 40x40 cm grey concrete tiles with concentric quarter-arc grooves (4 tiles make one circle). Worn, gum spots, food stains, cracks, one broken tile.
sidewalk_tile_circles_grey.method: procedural layout/wear (modelled on Thai references, see NOTES.md) over CC0 Poly Haven photo-scan detail

sidewalk_tile_grid_grey_redband.purpose: Common Thai footpath: 30x30 cm grey pressed-concrete tiles with a fine groove grid, one row of faded-red tiles as an accent band (runs along U). Pair with tactile_strip_yellow.
sidewalk_tile_grid_grey_redband.method: procedural layout/wear (modelled on Thai references, see NOTES.md) over CC0 Poly Haven photo-scan detail

sidewalk_tile_red_hex.purpose: Old-town Bangkok soi footpath: 30x30 cm red/pink pressed concrete tiles with polygon-star grooves; faded, dirty, cigarette/gum spots.
sidewalk_tile_red_hex.method: procedural layout/wear (modelled on Thai references, see NOTES.md) over CC0 Poly Haven photo-scan detail

tactile_strip_yellow.purpose: Yellow tactile guide paving strip with raised bars; lay along the footpath, tiles along V.
tactile_strip_yellow.method: procedural layout/wear (modelled on Thai references, see NOTES.md) over CC0 Poly Haven photo-scan detail

tarp_blue_photo.purpose: Blue woven tarpaulin (ผ้าใบฟ้า) from a real photo, tileable: stall roofs, cart covers, patched roofs.

trench_grate_cast_iron_photo.purpose: Cast-iron trench drain grate strip (real photo, rectified from a perspective view, tiles along V). Kerb gutters, market drains, shop-front channels.

wall_concrete_black_streaks.purpose: Grey concrete with heavy black water / mould streaks (tropical weathering) (real photo, made tileable).

wall_concrete_mould_stained.purpose: Board-marked concrete wall, mould and rain staining (real photo, made tileable).

wall_concrete_plain_dirty.purpose: Plain dirty cement render (real photo, made tileable).

wall_peeling_paint_orange.purpose: Orange-terracotta painted render flaking off in crusts (real photo, made tileable).

wall_peeling_paint_red_over_cream.purpose: Dark red paint peeling over a cream base coat (real photo, made tileable).

wall_peeling_paint_teal.purpose: Teal painted wall flaking to bare plaster, faint marker tag (real photo, made tileable).

window_grille_white_on_glass.purpose: Window with white steel burglar bars over glass, frame included (real photo, rectified). Upper-floor shophouse window.

window_wood_shutters_old.purpose: Old weathered wooden window shutters, closed, in a crumbling frame (real photo, rectified). Old wooden shophouses, canal houses, rural houses.

wire_bundle_tangle_photo.purpose: Tangled overhead cable bundles keyed out of real photos taken against the sky (alpha = cables, colour = dark rubber). 2 cells of 1024 (2x1) - use on alpha-tested crossed quads at pole tops / between poles.
